facts.statement: The promo is presented with the characters Chris and Lola.
facts.quote: ¡Echa un vistazo a Cofres Misterios Mecánicos en Free Realms con Chris y Lola!

article_summaries.title: Cosas Super Secretas: Cofres Misteriosos Mecánicos
article_summaries.summary: A short Spanish-language promo blurb from the official freerealms.com news page (captured 2012-11-03) about a Mechanical Mystery Chests feature, presented with the characters Chris and Lola. It says players can dance on a clockwork gear in the game and win prizes, with a free-to-play call to action. The post gives no date beyond 'Posted 2 months, 1 week ago', and no prize list or mechanics.
